# New Hire Onboarding Checklist

Before a new hire's first day, the hiring manager must confirm that a laptop has been provisioned, that the new hire's accounts exist in the identity provider, and that the new hire has received and returned a signed copy of their offer letter. On or before their first day, every new hire must sign the confidentiality and IP assignment agreement through the HR portal; payroll cannot be activated until that signed agreement is on file.

During the first week, new hires complete mandatory training on the code of conduct, workplace safety, and information security, and are assigned a peer buddy from their team who is not their manager. Benefits enrollment (health insurance, retirement contributions, and PTO accrual) must be completed within the first 30 days of employment, or the new hire is automatically defaulted into the standard plan at open enrollment.
